title.narrative: READ - Responding, Expanding and Acting on Disinformation

description.narrative: The global objective of READ is to contribute to the development and consolidation of the rule of law in Moldova with full respect of human rights and fundamental freedoms. The specific objective of READ is that independent media in Moldova have increased capacity and measures to counter disinformation, reach the public with reliable information, promote critical thinking among citizens and operate in a more enabling environment offline and online.
